newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA A WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA A WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: African A won the toss and elected to bat in their one-day match
against India in Pietermaritzburg on Thursday.
South Africa A - Gerhardus Liebenberg, Piet Botha, Louis
Koen, Herschelle Gibbs, John Commins (captain), Derek Crookes,
Mark Boucher, Nicky Boje, Ross Veenstra, Makhaya Ntini, Wayne
India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Rahul Dravid, Ajay
Jadeja, Robin Singh, Salil Ankola, Venkatesh Prasad, Nayan
Mongia, Vikram Rathore, Doda Ganesh, Pankaj Dharmani, Sunil
